scope: ClusLba, NextClus, FileLba and directory-read address checks in src/hack_scsd.c
finding: Cluster/address shifts and additions could wrap. File addressing could add an offset to a failed base. FAT cache initialization 0xFFFFFFFF could incorrectly match an unread FAT address.
change: Reject existing end markers, invalid shifts and overflowing cluster/FAT/file address calculations. Preserve the zero failure sentinel before adding file offsets. Directory lookup checks the cluster base/full address span and computes it once per cluster. Re-read when the cache still has its initialization marker.
verification: check_scsd_cluster_address.py: 6881280 cluster/type/data/shift cases with an independent 64-bit address oracle and four file offsets
FAT16/FAT32/exFAT chain traversal, FAT32 reserved entry-bit masking, cache hits, initialization-marker collision, address overflow and read failure checked
Baseline e5ec731 fails the same fixture; current source passes under trapping shift sanitizer
Existing mount, directory and file-read-bound checks pass; GNU ARM compilation passes without diagnostics
Directory caller inspected to reject a zero base or wrapping full cluster span before SD reads; its full event/name parser is not executed in this fixture
limitations: Controlled FAT sector reads and selected numeric cluster ranges. Device/volume capacity, all reserved/bad-cluster rules, cycles, exFAT name parsing, complete directory integration and real hardware remain unverified.
